title: Measure Twice
reference: repeat 2 { while not wall_ahead { forward tally_up } turn_right repeat tally { forward tally_down } turn_left }
hints: Walk to the end of the quay and count every step. The next stretch is just as long.
While there is no wall: step and count. Turn, then walk the tally back to 0.
repeat 2 { while not wall_ahead { forward tally_up } turn_right repeat tally { forward tally_down } turn_left }

story.intro: PATCH: "The Tally House. Nobody tells you how long these quays are. Walk to the wall, count every step, then walk that far again."
